tasks.title: Automated Integration Testing Setup
tasks.description: Add comprehensive integration tests to validate frontend and backend functionality
tasks.details:
Create automated integration tests including:

1. Frontend Integration Tests:
   - Page load validation (no JavaScript errors)
   - Navigation testing (Season, Agenda, Players pages)
   - UI component interactions (forms, buttons, date picker)
   - API call validation from frontend

2. Backend API Integration Tests:
   - REST endpoint response validation
   - Database operations testing
   - Season and player management workflows
   - Match date scheduling functionality

3. End-to-End Tests:
   - Complete user workflows (add players, schedule matches)
   - Data persistence verification
   - Frontend-backend integration validation

Use modern testing frameworks like Cypress or Playwright for frontend tests, and extend existing JUnit tests for backend integration testing.
tasks.testStrategy: Comprehensive test suite covering all major user workflows, API endpoints, and UI interactions with automated execution capability
